questions.text:
एक स्माटाफोन निर्माता कम्पनी के उच्च प्रबन्धन ने हाल ही में यह देखा कि सरकार ने स्माटाफोन में प्रयोग की जाने वाली बैटरी को अतितापन से बचाने के लिए नए सुरक्षा मानकों के आदेश पारित किए हैं। उसने यह भी देखा कि सरकार ने मोबाइल फोन में प्रयुक्त पुरजों पर आयात शुल्क में कमी की घोषणा की है।

व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के वे आयाम जिन पर उपर्युक्त स्थिति में प्रकाश डाला गया है, वे हैं :
questions.text_english:
The top management of a smartphone manufacturing company recently observed that the government has ordered new safety standards for batteries used in smartphones to prevent overheating. It also noticed that the government announced a reduction in import duties on components used in mobile phones.

The dimensions of business environment highlighted in the above case are :

options.C: विधिक एवं सामाजिक पर्यावरण
options.D: राजनीतिक एवं विधिक पर्यावरण

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Political and legal environments. The two events described in the case are: (1) the government ordering new safety standards for batteries — this is a legal/regulatory directive, reflecting the legal environment; and (2) the government announcing a reduction in import duties — this is a policy decision made by the government in power, reflecting the political environment. Neither event involves technological innovation by the company nor any social or cultural change, so options A, B, and C are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) राजनीतिक एवं विधिक पर्यावरण है। बैटरी के लिए नए सुरक्षा मानक सरकारी आदेश (विधिक पर्यावरण) और आयात शुल्क में कमी (राजनीतिक निर्णय) दोनों इन्हीं दो आयामों को दर्शाते हैं।

questions.text:
'टैन्गी बीवरेजिज लिमिटेड' अपने लोकप्रिय खट्टे फलों के रस के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। इसने हाल ही में फलों के रस की एक नई श्रृंखला पेश की, जो उपभोक्ताओं के बीच तुरंत प्रसिद्ध (हिट) हो गई और इससे कम्पनी के लाभों में काफी बढ़ोतरी हुई। परिणामस्वरूप, निदेशक मंडल इस वर्ष के लिए अधिक लाभांश घोषित करना चाहते थे। मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी ने सुझाव दिया कि निर्णय लेने से पहले वे पिछले वर्षों में शेयर मूल्य पर लाभांश के प्रभाव का मूल्यांकन करें। एक विश्लेषण किया गया, जिससे पता चला कि किस प्रकार पिछले वर्षों में जब भी लाभांश बढ़ाया गया कम्पनी के शेयर मूल्य बढ़ गए। जबकि दूसरी ओर लाभांश में थोड़ी-सी कमी से शेयर मूल्य में उल्लेखनीय गिरावट देखी गई।

उपर्युक्त स्थिति में मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी द्वारा निदेशक मंडल को निम्नलिखित में से लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले किस घटक का सुझाव दिया गया ?
questions.text_english:
'Tangy Beverages Ltd.' was known for its popular tangy fruit drinks. It had recently introduced a new range of fruit drinks that became an instant hit among consumers and led to a significant increase in the company's profits. As a result, the Board of Directors wanted to declare a higher dividend for the year. The Chief Finance Officer suggested that they should evaluate the impact of dividend on the share price of previous years before taking a decision. An analysis was done, which showed how the company's share price had risen in previous years whenever the dividend was increased. On the other hand, even a small decrease in dividend had led to a noticeable dip in the share price.

Which of the following factors affecting dividend decision was suggested by the Chief Finance Officer to the Board of Directors in the above case ?

options.C: अंशधारियों की प्राथमिकता
options.D: रोकड़ प्रवाह स्थिति

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Stock market reaction. The CFO specifically asked the Board to study how past changes in dividend affected the company's share price — when dividend rose, share price rose, and when it fell even slightly, share price fell noticeably. This pattern of the stock market responding to dividend changes is precisely the factor known as 'stock market reaction'. Access to capital market relates to a firm's ability to raise external funds, shareholders' preference relates to investors' personal inclination for dividends versus capital gains, and cash flow position relates to the company's liquidity — none of these match the CFO's specific suggestion here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) शेयर बाजार प्रतिक्रिया है। CFO ने लाभांश और शेयर मूल्य के ऐतिहासिक संबंध का अध्ययन करने को कहा, जो शेयर बाजार प्रतिक्रिया घटक को दर्शाता है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।

अभिकथन (A) : साधारण शक्तियाँ जैसे सामाजिक, राजनीतिक, विधिक तथा प्रौद्योगिकीय स्थितियाँ किसी व्यक्तिगत फर्म को केवल अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रभावित करती हैं।

कारण (R) : साधारण शक्तियों का सभी व्यावसायिक उद्यमों पर प्रभाव होता है, इसके विपरीत, विशिष्ट शक्तियाँ उनके दिन-प्रतिदिन के कामकाज में व्यक्तिगत फर्मों को तुरंत एवं प्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रभावित करती हैं।

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).

Assertion (A) : General forces such as social, political, legal and technological conditions affect an individual firm only indirectly.

Reason (R) : General forces have an impact on all business enterprises, in contrast to, specific forces that affect individual firms directly and immediately in their day-to-day working.

Choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों गलत हैं।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are incorrect.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion (A) is correct because general forces — social, political, legal and technological — operate at a macro level and do not target any single firm; their impact on an individual firm is therefore indirect. Reason (R) correctly explains why: general forces affect all enterprises equally across the industry, whereas specific forces (such as competitors, customers, and suppliers) directly and immediately influence a particular firm's day-to-day operations. The Reason directly justifies why the Assertion is true, making option A the right choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। दोनों कथन सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: किसी उत्पाद के मूल्य निर्धारण को प्रभावित करने वाले तत्त्वों में से एक तत्त्व 'मूल्य निर्धारण का उद्देश्य' है। निम्नलिखित में से किस मूल्य-निर्धारण उद्देश्य के परिणामस्वरूप उत्पाद के लिए ज्यादा मूल्य निश्चित किया जाएगा ?
questions.text_english: One of the factors affecting price determination of a product is 'Pricing Objectives'. Which of the following pricing objectives will result in a higher price being fixed for the product ?

options.A: बाजार हिस्सेदारी में अग्रणी/नेतृत्व प्राप्त करना
options.C: उत्पाद गुणवत्ता में नेतृत्व/अग्रिम स्थान प्राप्त करना
options.D: दीर्घ-अवधि में अधिकतम लाभ प्राप्त करना

options_english.D: Profit maximisation in the long run

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Attaining product quality leadership. When a company aims to be a quality leader, it invests heavily in superior raw materials, research and development, and rigorous quality controls, all of which raise the cost of production. To recover these higher costs and to signal premium quality to buyers, the company must set a higher price. In contrast, obtaining market share leadership requires a lower price to attract more buyers; surviving in a competitive market demands competitive pricing; and long-run profit maximisation does not necessarily require a high price in every situation — it may involve optimal pricing strategies. Only the quality-leadership objective inherently leads to a higher price.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) उत्पाद गुणवत्ता में नेतृत्व है। गुणवत्ता नेतृत्व के लिए उच्च लागत आती है इसलिए ऊँचा मूल्य रखा जाता है।

questions.text: ''प्रबन्ध के सिद्धांतों का प्रयोग एक विशेष समय की मौजूदा परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर करता है।'' यह कथन निम्नलिखित में से प्रबन्ध के सिद्धांतों की किस विशेषता पर प्रकाश डालता है ?
questions.text_english: "The application of principles of management is dependent upon the prevailing situation at a particular point of time." This statement highlights which of the following features of principles of management ?

options.C: मुख्यतः व्यावहारिक
options.D: अनिश्चित

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Contingent. The word 'contingent' means dependent on or conditioned by something else. The statement explicitly says that the application of management principles depends on the prevailing situation at a particular time — this is the very definition of the contingent nature of management principles. 'General guidelines' refers to the fact that principles give broad direction, not specific instructions. 'Flexible' means principles can be modified, but does not capture the idea of situation-dependence. 'Mainly behavioural' refers to the fact that principles deal with human behaviour. Only 'contingent' precisely captures the idea that their application varies with circumstances.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) अनिश्चित (Contingent) है। यह विशेषता बताती है कि सिद्धांतों का प्रयोग परिस्थिति पर निर्भर करता है।

questions.text:
'रिन्यू लिमिटेड' इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों के क्षेत्र में प्रथम अन्वेषक था और वर्तमान में उसका बाजार अंश 70% है। लोगों में पर्यावरण के प्रति बढ़ती हुई जागरूकता तथा कम प्रचालन लागतों के कारण इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों की तेजी से बढ़ती हुई माँग को ध्यान में रखते हुए, कम्पनी ने वर्तमान वर्ष में अपने बाजार अंश को 80% तक बढ़ाने का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया। फिर भी, सरकार द्वारा इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों के निर्माण को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए दिए जाने वाले प्रोत्साहनों ने बाजार में बहुत से नए प्रतिस्पर्धियों को आकर्षित किया। क्योंकि व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण में यह परिवर्तन अचानक हुआ, कम्पनी सही ढंग से भविष्य की प्रवृत्तियों का अनुमान लगाने में असमर्थ रही। परिणामस्वरूप, 'रिन्यू लिमिटेड' का बाजार अंश वर्तमान वर्ष में 70% से घटकर 55% हो गया।

उपर्युक्त स्थिति में नियोजन की किस सीमा पर चर्चा की गई है ?
questions.text_english:
'Renew Ltd.' was the pioneer in the Electric Vehicles segment and presently has 70% market share. Keeping in mind the rapidly increasing demand for Electric Vehicles due to the rising environment consciousness among people and lower operating costs, the company set a target to increase its market share to 80% in the current year. However, the incentives provided by the government to encourage manufacturing of Electric Vehicles attracted many new players in the market. As this change in the business environment happened suddenly, the company was not able to accurately assess future trends. As a result, the market share of 'Renew Ltd.' fell from 70% to 55% in the current year.

Which limitation of planning has been discussed in the above case ?

options.A: नियोजन परिवर्तनशील वातावरण में प्रभावी नहीं रहता
options.C: नियोजन सफलता का आश्वासन नहीं है
options.D: नियोजन में भारी लागत आती है

options_english.A: Planning may not work in a dynamic environment

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Planning may not work in a dynamic environment. The case clearly describes how a sudden and unexpected change in the business environment — the entry of new competitors due to government incentives — rendered the company's plans ineffective. The company could not accurately assess future trends because the environment changed rapidly and without warning. This is a classic illustration of the limitation that planning becomes ineffective in a dynamic or fast-changing environment. Option B (rigidity) is not indicated here, as the company was not reluctant to change plans. Option C (no guarantee of success) is a separate limitation not specifically highlighted. Option D (huge costs) is not discussed at all.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अचानक हुए पर्यावरणीय बदलाव के कारण नियोजन प्रभावी नहीं रहा — यही गतिशील वातावरण की सीमा है।

questions.text: मास्लो के आवश्यकता-क्रम अभिप्रेरणा के सिद्धांत के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन गलत है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following statements is incorrect with reference to Maslow's Need Hierarchy Theory of motivation ?

options.A: व्यक्तियों का व्यवहार उनकी आवश्यकताओं पर निर्भर करता है।
options.B: व्यक्तियों की आवश्यकताएँ एक क्रम श्रृंखला में होती हैं, आधारभूत आवश्यकताओं से प्रारंभ होकर अन्य उच्च-स्तरीय आवश्यकताओं तक।
options.C: एक आवश्यकता की संतुष्टि ही उस व्यक्ति को अभिप्रेरित कर सकती है।
options.D: एक व्यक्ति क्रम में अगले उच्चतर स्तर की आवश्यकता तभी अनुभव करता है जब उसके निचले स्तर की आवश्यकता की संतुष्टि हो जाती है।

options_english.A: People's behaviour is based on their needs.
options_english.B: People's needs are in hierarchical order, starting from basic needs to other higher level needs.
options_english.C: Only a satisfied need can motivate a person.
options_english.D: A person moves to the next higher level of the hierarchy only when the lower need is satisfied.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Only a satisfied need can motivate a person. This statement is incorrect because, according to Maslow's theory, it is an unsatisfied need that motivates a person, not a satisfied one. Once a need is satisfied, it no longer drives behaviour; only unfulfilled needs create the urge to act. Statements A, B, and D are all correct tenets of Maslow's theory: people's behaviour is indeed need-driven, needs are arranged in a hierarchy from physiological to self-actualisation, and a person advances to the next level only after the lower-level need is reasonably satisfied.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। मास्लो के अनुसार असंतुष्ट आवश्यकता ही व्यक्ति को अभिप्रेरित करती है, संतुष्ट नहीं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कारक एक कंपनी की पूँजी संरचना को प्रभावित नहीं करता ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a factor affecting capital structure of a company ?

options.C: वित्तीयन विकल्प
options.D: शेयर बाजार की दशाएँ

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Financing alternatives. Capital structure refers to the mix of debt and equity used to finance a firm's assets. The standard factors that affect capital structure decisions include cash flow position (ability to service debt), return on investment (whether borrowing is profitable), and stock market conditions (investor sentiment toward equity vs. debt). 'Financing alternatives' is not a recognised factor affecting capital structure in the standard CBSE Business Studies syllabus — it is more a consequence or a component of capital structure itself, not a determinant. Hence, (C) is the odd one out.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) वित्तीयन विकल्प है। यह पूँजी संरचना को प्रभावित करने वाला मान्य कारक नहीं है।

questions.text:
चित्र I से चित्र II में विपणन प्रबन्ध अवधारणा (दर्शन) में हुए परिवर्तन को पहचानिए :

टेलीविजन का बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन [चित्र I] → टेलीविजन का उपयोग एक कम्प्यूटर मॉनीटर के रूप में [चित्र II]
questions.text_english:
Identify the shift in the marketing management philosophy from Picture I to Picture II.

Mass Production of Televisions [Picture I] → Use of Television as a Computer Monitor [Picture II]

options.B: उत्पादन अवधारणा से सामाजिक विपणन अवधारणा
options.C: सामाजिक विपणन अवधारणा से उत्पादन अवधारणा
options.D: उत्पाद अवधारणा से उत्पादन अवधारणा

options_english.A: From Production concept to Product concept
options_english.B: From Production concept to Societal marketing concept
options_english.C: From Societal marketing concept to Production concept
options_english.D: From Product concept to Production concept

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) From Production concept to Product concept. Picture I shows mass production of televisions, which is the hallmark of the Production concept — the philosophy that consumers favour products that are available in large quantities at low prices. Picture II shows a television being used innovatively as a computer monitor, emphasising superior features and versatility — this is the Product concept, where focus shifts to product quality and innovation. The shift is therefore from Production concept (Picture I) to Product concept (Picture II). Options B, C, and D describe incorrect pairings.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) उत्पादन अवधारणा से उत्पाद अवधारणा है। बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन = उत्पादन अवधारणा; नवीन उपयोग = उत्पाद अवधारणा।

questions.text:
'डक्कन मोटर्स लिमिटेड' का भारत के ऑटोमोबाइल क्षेत्र में एक प्रसिद्ध नाम है। यह व्यावसायिक वाहनों जैसे बस, ट्रक तथा लॉरी और साथ ही यात्री वाहनों जैसे कार, स्कूटर आदि दोनों में व्यापार करती है। वर्तमान में इसका संगठनात्मक ढाँचा कार्यात्मक है। निदेशक मंडल ने अब इसे प्रभागीय ढाँचे में परिवर्तित करने का निर्णय लिया, जिसमें व्यावसायिक वाहनों तथा यात्री वाहनों के लिए अलग-अलग विभाग होंगे।

प्रभागीय ढाँचे में परिवर्तन के परिणामस्वरूप कम्पनी को जो लाभ मिलेगा उसे पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
'Deccan Motors Ltd.' is a renowned name in the automobile sector in India. It deals in both commercial vehicles like bus, truck and lorries, as well as passenger vehicles like cars, scooters, etc. It presently has a functional organisational structure. The Board of Directors have now decided to shift to divisional structure, with separate divisions for commercial vehicles and passenger vehicles.

Identify the benefit the company will get as a result of shifting to divisional structure :

options.A: इससे लचीलेपन और पहल को प्रोत्साहन मिलेगा क्योंकि प्रत्येक विभाग एक स्वायत्त इकाई की तरह कार्य करेगा।
options.B: इससे प्रयासों की पुनरावृत्ति कम होगी, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप पैमाने के लाभ मिलेंगे।
options.C: इससे कर्मचारियों का प्रशिक्षण आसान होगा क्योंकि केन्द्र-बिन्दु सीमित कौशल श्रृंखला होगी।
options.D: इससे व्यावसायिक विशिष्टीकरण को बढ़ावा मिलेगा क्योंकि विशिष्ट कार्यों पर बल दिया जाएगा।

options_english.A: It will promote flexibility and initiative because each division will function as an autonomous unit.
options_english.B: It will lead to minimal duplication of effort, which will result in economies of scale.
options_english.C: It will make training of employees easier as the focus will be on limited range of skills.
options_english.D: It will lead to occupational specialisation since emphasis will be placed on specific functions.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) It will promote flexibility and initiative because each division will function as an autonomous unit. A key advantage of the divisional structure is that each division operates as a semi-independent profit centre, giving divisional managers the freedom to take quick decisions suited to their specific product-market situation. This promotes both flexibility and initiative. Option B (minimal duplication and economies of scale) is actually an advantage of the functional structure, not the divisional one — divisional structure often leads to duplication since each division has its own support functions. Options C and D are also advantages of functional structure, not divisional.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। प्रभागीय ढाँचे में प्रत्येक विभाग स्वायत्त इकाई की तरह कार्य करता है, जिससे लचीलापन और पहल को बढ़ावा मिलता है।

questions.text: एक अधीनस्थ को सौंपे गए कार्य को भली-भाँति निष्पादित करने का दायित्व जाना जाता है ___________।
questions.text_english: Obligation of a subordinate to properly perform the assigned duty is known as ___________.

options.C: उत्तरदायित्व
options.D: अधिकार

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Responsibility. Responsibility is defined as the obligation of a subordinate to properly carry out the duties assigned to them by a superior. It arises out of a superior-subordinate relationship when the superior assigns work to the subordinate. Accountability (option B) refers to answerability for the outcome of the assigned tasks — it is enforced by the superior and cannot be delegated away. Authority (option D) is the right to give orders and take decisions. Delegation (option A) is the process of assigning duties, authority, and responsibility to a subordinate. Hence, the obligation to perform the assigned task is specifically termed 'Responsibility'.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) उत्तरदायित्व है। सौंपे गए कार्य को भली-भाँति निष्पादित करने का दायित्व उत्तरदायित्व कहलाता है।

questions.text:
एक सॉफ़्टवेयर कम्पनी अपने व्यवसाय को बढ़ाना चाहती है। इसके लिए उसे बड़ी संख्या में नए स्नातकों की आवश्यकता है जिनके पास कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस) तथा आँकड़ा विश्लेषण (डेटा ऐनालेटिक्स) के क्षेत्र में अभिनव विचार हों। विद्यमान स्टॉफ के सदस्य इन विशिष्ट कौशलों से संपन्न नहीं हैं अतः कार्यालय के स्वागत कक्ष पर एक नोटिस लगाया गया जिसमें वर्तमान कर्मचारियों से अपने मित्र या संबंधी को परिचित कराने के लिए कहा गया, जिनके पास संभवतः कार्य के लिए आवश्यक कौशल हो सकते हैं।

सॉफ़्टवेयर कम्पनी द्वारा उपयोग में लाया गया भर्ती का स्रोत है :
questions.text_english:
A software company wants to expand its business. For this, it requires a large number of fresh graduates with innovative ideas in the field of Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics. The existing staff members do not possess these specialized skills, so a notice was put up at the reception of the office asking the present employees to introduce any friend or relative who could possibly be possessing the required skills for the jobs.

The source of recruitment that has been used by the software company is :

options.C: स्थानान्तरण
options.D: पदोन्नति

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Recommendation of employees. The company asked its existing employees to refer friends or relatives who might have the required skills. This is an internal source of recruitment known as employee recommendation or employee referral. Direct recruitment (option A) involves hiring directly from educational institutions or through a gate notice. Transfer (option C) involves moving existing employees from one location or department to another. Promotion (option D) involves elevating existing employees to higher positions. Since the company is seeking fresh talent from outside by using existing employees as a bridge, it is clearly a case of recommendation of employees.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) कर्मचारियों द्वारा अनुशंसा है। वर्तमान कर्मचारियों से अपने परिचितों को संदर्भित कराना यही भर्ती का स्रोत है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :

कथन I : एक पेशे में प्रवेश न तो किसी परीक्षा के माध्यम से और न ही कोई शैक्षिक उपाधि प्राप्त करने से प्रतिबंधित है।

कथन II : किसी भी व्यावसायिक उद्यम में किसी भी व्यक्ति को प्रबंधक के रूप में मनोनीत करने अथवा नियुक्त करने पर कोई प्रतिबंध नहीं है चाहे शैक्षिक योग्यता कोई भी हो।

दिए गए कथनों के प्रकाश में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :

Statement I : The entry to a profession is not restricted either through an examination or through acquiring an educational degree.

Statement II : There is no restriction on anyone being designated or appointed as a manager in any business enterprise irrespective of the educational qualifications possessed.

In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Statement I is false and Statement II is true. Statement I is false because entry into a profession is indeed restricted — it requires passing specified examinations and obtaining recognised educational degrees or certifications (e.g., a doctor must have an MBBS degree, a lawyer must pass the bar). Therefore, the claim that entry is not restricted is incorrect. Statement II is true because management is not yet a recognised profession in the strict sense — there is no law that prohibits a person without formal management qualifications from being appointed as a manager. Any person, regardless of educational background, can be appointed as a manager in a business enterprise.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। कथन I असत्य है — पेशे में प्रवेश परीक्षा/उपाधि से प्रतिबंधित होता है। कथन II सत्य है — प्रबंधन में कोई भी नियुक्त हो सकता है।

questions.text:
एक अग्रणी समाचार-पत्र कम्पनी ने देखा कि प्रतिस्पर्धी वेतन का भुगतान करने के बावजूद भी बहुत से प्रतिभाशाली संपादक त्यागपत्र दे रहे थे। एक आन्तरिक सर्वेक्षण करने के बाद यह ज्ञात हुआ कि कर्मचारी असंतुष्ट थे क्योंकि उन्हें अन्य प्रतिस्पर्धी फर्मों के कर्मचारियों की भाँति वेतन के अतिरिक्त कोई लाभ नहीं दिया जाता था। यह समझते हुए कि ऐसे अतिरिक्त लाभ कर्मचारियों को अभिप्रेरित करने में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं, प्रबन्धन ने कार-भत्ता, घर की सुविधा, चिकित्सा लाभ आदि देने का निर्णय लिया ताकि कर्मचारियों को संगठन में बनाए रखा जा सके और उनकी संतुष्टि में सुधार हो।

उस प्रोत्साहन को पहचानिए जिसे समाचार-पत्र कम्पनी ने अपने कर्मचारियों को देने का निर्णय लिया :
questions.text_english:
A leading newspaper company noticed that many of its talented editors were resigning despite being paid competitive salaries. On conducting an internal survey, it was revealed that employees were dissatisfied as they were not being offered benefits over and above the salary, like the employees of other competitive firms. Realising that such additional benefits play an important role in motivating employees, the management decided to provide car allowance, housing facilities, medical benefits, etc. to retain employees in the organisation and improve their satisfaction.

Identify the incentive that the newspaper company decided to provide to their employees :

options.C: अनुलाभ (परक्विजिट्स)
options.D: लाभ में भागीदारी

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Perquisites. Perquisites (also called perks) are additional benefits provided to employees over and above their regular salary, such as car allowance, company housing, medical facilities, and similar non-cash benefits. The case specifically mentions car allowance, housing facilities, and medical benefits — all of which are classic examples of perquisites. Bonus (option A) is a one-time financial payment linked to performance. Retirement benefits (option B) are paid after the employee leaves the organisation. Profit sharing (option D) involves giving employees a share of the company's profits. None of these match the benefits described in the question.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) अनुलाभ (परक्विजिट्स) है। कार-भत्ता, आवास, चिकित्सा लाभ — ये सभी अनुलाभ के उदाहरण हैं।

questions.text: कॉलम-I में दिए गए योजना के प्रकार का कॉलम-II में दिए गए इसके अर्थ से मिलान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Match the type of plan given in Column-I with its meaning in Column-II :

options.C: a-(iv), b-(ii), c-(iii), d-(i)
options.D: a-(iv), b-(i), c-(ii), d-(iii)

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) a-(iv), b-(ii), c-(i), d-(iii). Policy (a) is a general statement that guides thinking and channelises energies — this matches (iv). Programme (b) is a detailed statement about a project outlining objectives, policies, procedures, rules, tasks, resources, and budget — this matches (ii). Method (c) is the prescribed way or manner of performing a specific task — this matches (i). Strategy (d) is a comprehensive plan for accomplishing organisational objectives taking the business environment into account — this matches (iii).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: नीति-(iv), कार्यक्रम-(ii), विधि-(i), व्यूह-रचना-(iii)।

questions.text: एक डिपॉजिटरी प्रतिभागी (DP) के साथ डीमैट खाता खोलने का उद्देश्य है :
questions.text_english: The purpose of opening a Demat Account with a Depository Participant (DP) is :

options.A: डीमैट रूप में प्रतिभूतियों को धारण करना और स्थानान्तरित करना
options.B: दलाल के साथ कोई समझौता करना
options.C: प्रतिभूतियों के किसी भी क्रय के लिए शेयर बाजार को भुगतान करना
options.D: प्रतिभूति बाजार में नगद लेनदेनों को सक्षम बनाना

options_english.A: For holding and transferring securities in the Demat form
options_english.B: For entering into an agreement with broker
options_english.C: For making payment to stock exchange for any purchase of securities
options_english.D: For enabling cash transactions in the securities market

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) For holding and transferring securities in the Demat form. A Demat (dematerialised) account is an electronic account maintained by a Depository Participant (DP) that holds an investor's securities in dematerialised (electronic) form, eliminating the need for physical share certificates. Securities can be bought, sold, and transferred electronically through this account. Options B, C, and D are incorrect — the Demat account is not used to enter broker agreements, to make payments to the stock exchange, or to facilitate cash transactions.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। डीमैट खाते में प्रतिभूतियाँ इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखी और स्थानान्तरित की जाती हैं।

questions.text: नियुक्तिकरण प्रक्रिया का वह चरण जिसमें किसी कर्मचारी की वर्तमान और/या भूतपूर्व निष्पादन का कुछ पूर्व-निर्धारित मानकों के आधार पर मूल्यांकन किया जाता है :
questions.text_english: The step of the staffing process in which an employee's current and/or past performance is evaluated against certain pre-determined standards is :

options.C: पदोन्नति एवं कैरियर नियोजन
options.D: भर्ती

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Performance appraisal. Performance appraisal is the systematic process of evaluating an employee's current and past performance against pre-established standards. It helps identify strengths and weaknesses, guides training needs, and informs decisions about promotions, pay revisions, or transfers. Placement and orientation (option A) refers to assigning a job role and introducing a new employee to the organisation. Promotion and career planning (option C) follows appraisal but is not the appraisal step itself. Recruitment (option D) is the process of finding and attracting potential candidates — it occurs before selection and appointment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) निष्पादन मूल्यांकन है। पूर्व-निर्धारित मानकों के विरुद्ध कर्मचारी के निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन निष्पादन मूल्यांकन कहलाता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसमें कार्यशील पूँजी की आवश्यकता अधिक (उच्च) होगी ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following will require higher working capital ?

options.C: उच्च-स्तरीय प्रतियोगिता में
options.D: देनदारों के प्रति कठोर उधार नीति से

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Trading organisations. Trading organisations buy and sell goods in large volumes, requiring substantial amounts of working capital to maintain inventory and extend credit to customers. Short processing cycles (option B) mean that raw materials are converted into finished goods quickly, reducing the amount of working capital locked up at any given time. A strict credit policy towards debtors (option D) means the company recovers cash faster, reducing working capital needs. High level of competition (option C) may force a company to offer longer credit, which increases working capital, but trading organisations have a consistently higher working capital requirement as a direct result of their business model.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) व्यापारिक संगठन है। इनमें बड़ी मात्रा में माल और देनदार होते हैं, इसलिए अधिक कार्यशील पूँजी चाहिए।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :

कथन I : लोकतांत्रिक नेतृत्व शैली में, अनुयायियों को अपने उद्देश्यों और उन्हें प्राप्त करने के तरीकों को स्वयं तैयार करने के लिए उच्च स्तर की स्वतन्त्रता दी जाती है।

कथन II : निरंकुश/एकतंत्रीय नेतृत्व शैली में, अधीनस्थों के साथ सम्प्रेषण केवल एकमार्गीय होता है, वे केवल अपने प्रबन्धकों द्वारा दिए गए आदेशों के अनुसार कार्य करते हैं।

दिए गए कथनों के प्रकाश में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :

Statement I : In democratic leadership style, the followers are given a high degree of independence to formulate their own objectives and ways to achieve them.

Statement II : In autocratic leadership style, communication is only one-way, with the subordinates only acting according to the command given by their managers.

In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Statement I is false and Statement II is true. Statement I is false because it confuses the democratic (participative) style with the laissez-faire (free-rein) style. In democratic leadership, followers are involved in decision-making and consulted, but they are not given unlimited independence to set their own goals and methods — that is the characteristic of the laissez-faire style. Statement II is correct: in an autocratic leadership style, the leader makes all decisions unilaterally and communicates them downward as commands. Communication is strictly one-way, and subordinates are not invited to participate or give feedback.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। कथन I असत्य है — स्वयं उद्देश्य तैयार करना लाईसेज़-फेयर शैली है, लोकतांत्रिक नहीं। कथन II सत्य है — निरंकुश में सम्प्रेषण एकमार्गीय होता है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।

अभिकथन (A) : निवेशक जनता शेयर बाजार में एक सुरक्षित एवं निष्पक्ष लेनदेन पाती है।

कारण (R) : शेयर बाजार की सदस्यता उचित ढंग से नियंत्रित होती है और इसके लेनदेन विद्यमान कानूनी ढाँचे के अनुसार सुपरिभाषित होते हैं।

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).

Assertion (A) : The investing public gets a safe and fair deal on the stock market.

Reason (R) : The membership of stock exchange is well regulated and its dealings are well defined according to the existing legal framework.

Choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों गलत हैं।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are incorrect.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion (A) is true: investors on a stock exchange receive safe and fair treatment because the exchange operates under a well-defined regulatory framework. Reason (R) is also true and directly explains the Assertion: the stock exchange regulates its membership strictly and ensures that all transactions are conducted according to established legal rules, which is precisely why the investing public can trust the market for safe and fair deals. R directly justifies why A is true, making option A the right answer.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है क्योंकि सदस्यता नियंत्रण ही सुरक्षित लेनदेन का कारण है।

'प्रीमियर लिमिटेड' एक कपड़ा कम्पनी है जो उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले वस्त्रों तथा पर्यावरण स्थिरता के प्रति इसकी दृढ़ प्रतिबद्धता के लिए जानी जाती है। कम्पनी अपने वर्तमान एवं संभावित क्रेताओं की आवश्यकताओं को ध्यानपूर्वक समझकर कपड़ों को डिजाइन करती है और प्रभावपूर्ण ढंग से उनकी संतुष्टि करती है। यह मानती है कि लाभ को केवल तभी अधिकतम किया जा सकता है जब सभी निर्णय ग्राहक संतुष्टि को ध्यान में रखकर लिए जाते हैं। ग्राहक की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के साथ-साथ, 'प्रीमियर लिमिटेड' समाज के दीर्घकालीन कल्याण के प्रति गहरी चिंता भी दर्शाती है। पर्यावरणीय प्रदूषण को कम करने के लिए कम्पनी जैविक कपास एवं पुन:नवीनीकृत पॉलिएस्टर का उपयोग कर रही है। कचरे को कम करने के लिए, वे एक कार्यक्रम चलाते हैं जहाँ ग्राहक पुराने कपड़े पुन:नवीनीकरण के लिए वापस कर सकते हैं तथा नए कपड़ों पर छूट प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। इतना ही नहीं वे अपने लाभों का एक भाग स्थानीय विद्यालयों में पर्यावरणीय शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों के लिए अलग रखते हैं।

'प्रीमियर लिमिटेड' द्वारा अनुसरण की जाने वाली विपणन प्रबन्ध की दो अवधारणाओं (दर्शनों) को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
'Premier Ltd.' is a clothing company known for its high quality apparel and strong commitment to environment sustainability. The company designs its clothing after carefully understanding the needs of its present and prospective buyers and satisfying them in an effective manner. It assumes that profit can be maximised only when all decisions are taken from the point of view of customer satisfaction. Along with meeting customer needs, 'Premier Ltd.' also shows a deep concern for the long-term well-being of the society. To reduce environmental pollution, the company is using organic cotton and recycled polyester. For reducing waste, they run a programme where customers can return old clothes for recycling and get a discount on new clothes. Not only this, they keep aside a portion of its profits for environmental education programmes in local schools.

Identify and explain two marketing management philosophies followed by 'Premier Ltd.'.

key_points: Marketing Concept — understanding and satisfying customer needs to maximise profit
Societal Marketing Concept — balancing customer needs with long-term societal and environmental well-being

questions.solution: The two marketing management philosophies followed by 'Premier Ltd.' are the Marketing Concept and the Societal Marketing Concept. The Marketing Concept holds that an organisation can achieve its goals by identifying the needs of its target customers and satisfying them more effectively than competitors. Premier Ltd. follows this philosophy by carefully understanding buyer needs and designing clothing accordingly, believing that profit maximisation is possible only when customer satisfaction drives all decisions. The Societal Marketing Concept goes a step further by insisting that while satisfying customer needs, the firm must also protect and enhance the long-term well-being of society. Premier Ltd. demonstrates this by using organic cotton and recycled polyester to reduce pollution, running a cloth-recycling programme, and setting aside profits for environmental education in local schools.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three points of importance of Financial Planning.

key_points: Ensures availability of adequate funds at the right time
Helps in avoiding wastage by linking expenditure to goals
Enables firms to face uncertainties by creating reserves

sub_questions.solution: Financial planning is important for the following three reasons. First, it ensures that adequate funds are available whenever needed, so the business does not face a shortage of capital at critical moments. Second, it helps avoid excessive or wasteful expenditure by clearly linking every outflow to a defined business objective, thereby promoting cost discipline. Third, it prepares the organisation to handle future uncertainties and contingencies; by anticipating possible financial risks and creating reserves or arranging backup funding in advance, the firm can continue operations smoothly even in adverse conditions.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three factors that determine the requirement of fixed capital of a company.

key_points: Nature of business — manufacturing firms need more fixed capital than trading firms
Scale of operations — larger operations require more fixed assets
Technology used — capital-intensive technology requires higher fixed capital investment

sub_questions.solution: The requirement of fixed capital of a company is determined by the following three factors. First, the nature of business plays a crucial role — manufacturing companies require heavy investment in plant, machinery, and equipment, whereas trading or service companies need relatively less fixed capital. Second, the scale of operations matters — a firm operating on a large scale needs more fixed assets such as bigger factories and warehouses compared to a small-scale firm. Third, the type of technology adopted affects fixed capital — companies using capital-intensive technology require more investment in sophisticated machinery and equipment, while those using labour-intensive processes need less fixed capital.

questions.text_english:
'DF Telecom Ltd.', which produces a range of mobile phones for the Indian market, set a target to produce 30,000 units of mobile phones in the month of December 2025. This was the benchmark against which actual performance would be measured. At the end of the month, it was found that only 27,000 units were produced.

Concerned with the shortfall, the General Manager asked the Production Manager to find out and resolve the problem.

State the steps related to the process of one of the functions of management which the Production Manager has to take to find out and resolve the problem.

key_points: Measuring actual performance — determine that only 27,000 units were produced against the target of 30,000
Comparing actual performance with standards — identify the deviation of 3,000 units
Analysing deviations and taking corrective action — find the cause and fix it

questions.solution: The function of management involved here is Controlling. The Production Manager must follow these steps. First, he must measure the actual performance — he has already found that actual output was 27,000 units against the standard of 30,000 units. Second, he must compare this actual performance with the set standard — the deviation is 3,000 units, which is significant and requires investigation. Third, he must analyse the deviations to find the root cause of the shortfall, such as machine breakdown, absenteeism, supply delays, or inefficiency. Fourth, he must take corrective action to remove the cause — this could involve repairing machinery, arranging extra shifts, improving material supply, or retraining workers so that the target is met in the coming period.

sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Capital Market' and 'Money Market' on the basis of the following : (i) Investment outlay (ii) Liquidity (iii) Safety

key_points: Investment outlay: Capital market requires larger investment; money market instruments can be acquired with smaller amounts
Liquidity: Money market instruments are highly liquid; capital market instruments are less liquid
Safety: Money market is safer (short-term, low risk); capital market is riskier (long-term)

sub_questions.solution: Capital Market and Money Market differ on the following bases. Regarding investment outlay, the capital market generally requires a larger investment because it deals in long-term securities such as shares and debentures; by contrast, money market instruments can often be purchased with smaller amounts since they are high-denomination short-term instruments traded primarily by institutions. Regarding liquidity, money market instruments are highly liquid because they have short maturities (often less than one year) and a well-organised secondary market; capital market instruments are comparatively less liquid since they involve long-term commitments and depend more on secondary market conditions for exit. Regarding safety, the money market is considered safer because short-term instruments carry lower risk of default and price fluctuation; the capital market is riskier since long-term securities are more susceptible to economic changes, business risks, and market volatility.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three development functions of Securities and Exchange Board of India.

key_points: Training of intermediaries in securities market
Conducting research and publishing information useful for all market participants
Promoting investor education and awareness

sub_questions.solution: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) performs the following three developmental functions. First, SEBI trains intermediaries such as brokers, sub-brokers, and merchant bankers to develop professional standards in the securities market, thereby improving overall market quality. Second, SEBI conducts research on various aspects of the securities market and publishes information that is useful to investors, companies, and market participants, helping create a more informed and transparent marketplace. Third, SEBI promotes investor education and awareness through campaigns, workshops, and educational materials so that ordinary investors understand their rights and the risks involved in investing, which ultimately deepens the securities market and encourages broader participation.

sub_questions.text: व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के महत्त्व के निम्नलिखित बिन्दुओं को समझाइए : (i) उपयोगी संसाधनों के दोहन में सहायक (ii) तीव्रता से हो रहे परिवर्तनों का सामना करने में सहायक
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following points of importance of business environment : (i) Helps in tapping useful resources (ii) Helps in coping with rapid changes

key_points: Tapping resources: awareness of environment helps firms identify and access human, financial, and raw material resources
Coping with change: scanning the environment alerts managers to upcoming changes, enabling proactive rather than reactive responses

sub_questions.solution: Understanding the business environment is important for an organisation in the following two ways. First, it helps in tapping useful resources. Every business needs inputs such as raw materials, skilled labour, capital, and technology. A thorough understanding of the business environment — including government policies, market conditions, and technological trends — helps managers identify the best available sources for these inputs and acquire them at competitive prices. For instance, awareness of new government subsidies may help a firm access cheaper capital, or knowledge of technological advances may allow it to adopt more efficient production methods. Second, it helps in coping with rapid changes. The business environment is constantly changing due to shifts in consumer preferences, new competition, regulatory amendments, and economic fluctuations. Managers who regularly scan and monitor the environment can anticipate these changes early and adjust their strategies proactively, rather than reacting in a crisis. This preparedness reduces risk and improves the organisation's ability to stay competitive and relevant in dynamic conditions.

sub_questions.text: वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्ध की निम्नलिखित तकनीकों को समझाइए : (i) कार्य पद्धति अध्ययन (ii) कार्य का प्रमापीकरण एवं सरलीकरण
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following techniques of Scientific Management : (i) Method study (ii) Standardisation and simplification of work

key_points: Method study: finding the best way to perform a task to minimise costs and maximise efficiency
Standardisation and simplification: setting uniform methods and reducing unnecessary variety to improve efficiency

sub_questions.solution: The two techniques of Scientific Management proposed by F.W. Taylor are as follows. Method Study is the process of finding the best possible way to perform a specific task or job. It involves observing and analysing various ways a task can be carried out and then selecting the most efficient sequence of operations. The objective is to minimise the movement of workers and materials, reduce fatigue, save time, and lower costs. For example, by studying the movement of workers on an assembly line, managers can redesign the workflow so that unnecessary steps are eliminated and each worker operates at peak efficiency. Standardisation and Simplification of Work involves setting uniform standards for tools, equipment, materials, and working conditions, while simultaneously reducing unnecessary variety in products, processes, or equipment. Standardisation ensures that the best methods and materials are adopted universally within the organisation, leading to consistency and quality. Simplification eliminates unnecessary types and grades of products, which reduces inventory costs and makes production more streamlined and economical.

questions.solution: See sub-questions (a) and (b) above for detailed answers.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four features of coordination.

key_points: Coordination integrates group effort
Coordination ensures unity of action
Coordination is a continuous process
Coordination is the responsibility of every manager

sub_questions.solution: Coordination has the following four important features. First, coordination integrates group effort: it brings together the activities of individuals and departments into a unified whole, ensuring that all efforts are directed towards the common organisational goal rather than scattered in different directions. Second, coordination ensures unity of action: it synchronises the activities of various departments and individuals so that all their actions complement one another and there is no conflict or duplication, thus producing a unified and effective outcome. Third, coordination is a continuous process: it is not a one-time activity but an ongoing function that managers must perform at every step — from planning through to controlling — because the nature of organisational activities constantly changes and requires constant integration. Fourth, coordination is the responsibility of every manager: it is not limited to top management alone; every manager at every level must coordinate the activities of their team or department with those of others to ensure smooth functioning of the entire organisation.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के महत्त्व के किन्हीं चार बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four points of importance of management.

key_points: Management helps in achieving group goals
Management increases efficiency
Management creates a dynamic organisation
Management helps in achieving personal objectives

sub_questions.solution: Management is important for the following four reasons. First, management helps in achieving group goals: it coordinates the efforts of all individuals working in an organisation so that their combined effort is directed towards the common organisational objectives, which no single individual could achieve alone. Second, management increases efficiency: by optimising the use of available resources — human, financial, material, and technological — management ensures that output is maximised at minimum cost, reducing waste and improving productivity. Third, management creates a dynamic organisation: in a constantly changing environment, management helps the organisation adapt to new challenges by encouraging innovation, updating processes, and resolving internal conflicts so that the organisation remains competitive and responsive. Fourth, management helps in achieving personal objectives: good management provides a positive work environment where employees can grow, develop their skills, earn promotions, and achieve their personal career goals alongside the organisation's goals, thereby aligning individual and organisational interests.

questions.solution: See sub-questions (a) and (b) above for detailed answers.

questions.topic: Importance of Management / Features of Coordination

questions.text:
'रतन लिमिटेड' तथा 'लारा लिमिटेड' दो कम्पनियाँ हैं और प्रत्येक की विनियोजित पूँजी ₹ 20,00,000 है। 'रतन लिमिटेड' ने अंशों को निर्गमित कर कोष एकत्रित किए हैं जबकि 'लारा लिमिटेड' की पूँजी में 60% समता (₹ 100 प्रत्येक के अंशों में) तथा 40% ऋण (8% ऋणपत्रों से मिलकर बना) है। दोनों कम्पनियों का निवेश पर प्रत्याय 10% है तथा कर दर 40% है।

कारण सहित उल्लेख कीजिए कि कौन-सी कम्पनी अंशधारियों को बेहतर प्रतिफल देगी। अपनी गणनाओं को स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए।
questions.text_english:
'Ratan Ltd.' and 'Lara Ltd.' are two companies with each having a capital employed of ₹ 20,00,000. 'Ratan Ltd.' had raised funds by issuing shares whereas 'Lara Ltd.'s' capital has 60% equity (in shares of ₹ 100 each) and 40% debt (comprising of 8% debentures). Both the companies have a Return on Investment of 10% and the tax rate is 40%.

State with reason which company will be able to give a better return to the shareholders. Show your calculations clearly.

key_points: Ratan Ltd. — all equity, no interest, EPS calculation
Lara Ltd. — 60% equity + 40% debt at 8%, interest deducted before tax, EPS calculation
Lara Ltd. gives higher EPS due to financial leverage

questions.solution:
Ratan Ltd. (All Equity):
Capital Employed = ₹ 20,00,000 (all equity)
EBIT = 10% of ₹ 20,00,000 = ₹ 2,00,000
Less: Interest = ₹ 0
EBT = ₹ 2,00,000
Less: Tax @ 40% = ₹ 80,000
EAT = ₹ 1,20,000
Number of shares = ₹ 20,00,000 ÷ ₹ 100 = 20,000 shares
EPS = ₹ 1,20,000 ÷ 20,000 = ₹ 6 per share

Lara Ltd. (60% Equity + 40% Debt):
Equity = 60% of ₹ 20,00,000 = ₹ 12,00,000
Debt = 40% of ₹ 20,00,000 = ₹ 8,00,000
EBIT = 10% of ₹ 20,00,000 = ₹ 2,00,000
Less: Interest on Debentures = 8% of ₹ 8,00,000 = ₹ 64,000
EBT = ₹ 1,36,000
Less: Tax @ 40% = ₹ 54,400
EAT = ₹ 81,600
Number of equity shares = ₹ 12,00,000 ÷ ₹ 100 = 12,000 shares
EPS = ₹ 81,600 ÷ 12,000 = ₹ 6.80 per share

Conclusion: Lara Ltd. will give a better return to shareholders with an EPS of ₹ 6.80, compared to ₹ 6.00 for Ratan Ltd. This is because Lara Ltd. uses financial leverage — the interest on debt is tax-deductible, and since the return on investment (10%) exceeds the cost of debt (8%), the use of debt enhances returns for equity shareholders.

questions.text:
ऋषभ ने ₹ 8,00,000 में एक कार खरीदी। उसने उसी दिन ऐलेक्स इंश्योरेंस कम्पनी से कार का बीमा कराया। ऋषभ की कार केडवान में चोरी हो गई, जब वह अपने परिवार के साथ छुट्टी पर था। उसने तत्काल प्रथम सूचना रिपोर्ट (FIR) दर्ज करवाई, बीमाकर्ता को सूचित किया तथा सभी आवश्यक प्रलेख जमा करा दिए।

ऋषभ को बहुत बड़ा झटका लगा, जब बीमा कम्पनी ने उसके दावे को अस्वीकार कर दिया, यह आरोप लगाते हुए कि वह उचित सावधानी रखने में विफल रहा है और उसने कार की पार्किंग बहुत असुरक्षित ढंग से की थी। इसे चुनौती देने का संकल्प लेते हुए, ऋषभ ने बीमा कम्पनी को बहुत से पत्र लिखे, परंतु बीमा कम्पनी ने क्षतिपूर्ति का भुगतान करने के लिए मना कर दिया।

ऋषभ ने जिला कमीशन में मुक़दमा दायर कराया। जिला कमीशन शिकायत की यथार्थता से संतुष्ट था और उसने बीमा कम्पनी को उचित राशि के भुगतान का आदेश दिया।

ऋषभ द्वारा प्रयोग किए गए दो उपभोक्ता अधिकारों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
Rishabh purchased a car for ₹ 8,00,000. He insured the car on the same day from Alex Insurance Company. Rishabh's car was stolen in Kedwan while he was on vacation with his family. He promptly filed a First Information Report (FIR), informed the insurer and submitted all the required documents.

To Rishabh's shock, the insurance company rejected his claim, alleging he had failed to take due care and had parked the car in an unsafe manner. Determined to challenge this, Rishabh wrote multiple letters to the insurance company, but the insurance company refused to pay the compensation.

Rishabh filed a case with District Commission. The District Commission was satisfied with the genuineness of the complaint and ordered the insurance company to pay a reasonable amount.

Identify and explain two consumer rights which have been exercised by Rishabh.

key_points: Right to be heard — writing letters to the insurance company to have his complaint considered
Right to seek redressal — filing a case with the District Commission and getting compensation ordered

questions.solution: Rishabh exercised the following two consumer rights. The first is the Right to be Heard. This right ensures that consumer interests will receive due consideration at appropriate forums. Rishabh exercised this right when he wrote multiple letters to the insurance company to draw their attention to his legitimate claim and demand that his complaint be properly considered. Although the insurance company initially refused to respond favourably, Rishabh persisted in asserting his right to have his grievance heard. The second is the Right to Seek Redressal. This right provides consumers with the means to obtain fair settlement of genuine grievances through a legal mechanism. Rishabh exercised this right by filing a complaint with the District Consumer Commission. The Commission, after hearing the matter, found the complaint genuine and ordered the insurance company to pay a reasonable amount of compensation, demonstrating that consumers have a legal avenue for redressal against unfair trade practices or denial of legitimate claims.
questions.solution_hindi: (1) सुने जाने का अधिकार — बीमा कम्पनी को पत्र लिखना; (2) निवारण पाने का अधिकार — जिला कमीशन में मुक़दमा दायर करना और मुआवजा प्राप्त करना।

हितेश ने हाल ही में एक वस्त्र निर्माणी कम्पनी आरम्भ की थी। लेकिन, उसने जल्द ही बहुत-सी समस्याओं का सामना करना आरम्भ कर दिया जैसे लक्ष्यों का प्राप्त न होना, प्रबन्धकों के मध्य संघर्ष, श्रम की उच्च आवर्त दर आदि। उसने यह पता लगाने के लिए कि क्या गलत हो रहा था, एक प्रबन्ध परामर्शदाता को काम पर रखा। परामर्शदाता ने जाँच-पड़ताल की और निम्नलिखित राय (टिप्पणी) दी :

(i) उत्पादन विभाग में, कामगार उत्पादन प्रबंधक तथा विपणन प्रबन्धक दोनों से आदेश प्राप्त कर रहे थे। परिणामस्वरूप, किए जाने वाले कार्यों के सम्बन्ध में अत्यधिक भ्रांति थी।

(ii) पदोन्नति केवल महिला कर्मचारियों को दी जा रही थी। अन्य कर्मचारियों को कम्पनी में पदोन्नति के समान अवसर नहीं मिल रहे थे।

फेयोल द्वारा दिए गए प्रबन्ध के उन दो सिद्धान्तों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए जिनका पालन हितेश की कम्पनी में नहीं किया जा रहा है।
questions.text_english:
Hitesh started a garment manufacturing company recently. However, he soon began facing several problems like targets not met, conflicts among managers, high labour turnover, etc. He hired a management consultant to find out what was going wrong. The consultant conducted investigations and gave the following observations :

(i) In Production Department, workers were receiving instructions from both, the Production Manager and the Marketing Manager. As a result, there was a lot of confusion regarding tasks to be done.

(ii) Promotions were given only to women employees. Other employees did not get equal opportunities in the company to rise.

Identify and explain the two principles of management given by Fayol which are not being followed in Hitesh's company.

key_points: Unity of Command — workers should receive instructions from one superior only
Equity — all employees should be treated fairly and with equal justice

questions.solution: The two principles of Fayol that are being violated in Hitesh's company are as follows. The first is the Principle of Unity of Command. This principle states that each employee should receive orders and instructions from one superior only. In Hitesh's company, workers in the Production Department were receiving orders from both the Production Manager and the Marketing Manager. This dual command created confusion about which instructions to follow, leading to inefficiency, role conflict, and missed targets. According to Fayol, if an employee receives orders from two superiors simultaneously, authority is undermined and discipline breaks down. The second is the Principle of Equity. This principle states that all employees should be treated fairly and with justice, without any discrimination. In Hitesh's company, promotions were being given exclusively to women employees, while other employees were denied equal opportunities for advancement. This discriminatory treatment violated the principle of equity, resulting in demotivation and high labour turnover among other workers who felt unfairly treated.
questions.solution_hindi: (i) आदेश की एकता का सिद्धांत — एक अधीनस्थ को एक ही उच्चाधिकारी से आदेश मिलने चाहिए; (ii) समता का सिद्धांत — सभी कर्मचारियों के साथ समान और न्यायपूर्ण व्यवहार होना चाहिए।

'एएल पब्लिक स्कूल' के कक्षा 11 के विद्यार्थियों ने कक्षा 12 के विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक विदाई समारोह आयोजित करने का निर्णय लिया। एक कोर टीम का गठन किया गया और विचार-मंथन के बाद विभिन्न क्रियाओं की पहचान की गई जिन्हें इस कार्य के लिए निष्पादित किया जाना आवश्यक था। यह निर्णय लिया गया कि अल्पाहार, ध्वनि और संगीत, टेंट, उपहार, आमंत्रण तथा सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम की व्यवस्थाएँ करनी होंगी। इसके बाद विद्यार्थियों ने कार्य को प्रबन्धनीय गतिविधियों में विभाजित किया ताकि कार्य की पुनरावृत्ति को रोका जा सके तथा कार्य का बोझ विभाजित हो जाए।

विद्यार्थी बहुत उत्साहित थे कि वे स्वयं पूरे कार्य का प्रबन्धन कर रहे थे।

(i) कक्षा 11 के विद्यार्थियों ने संगठन-प्रक्रिया के एक कदम को निष्पादित किया। कदम को पहचानिए।
(ii) संगठन-प्रक्रिया को सफलतापूर्वक सम्पन्न करने के लिए विद्यार्थियों द्वारा निष्पादित किए जाने के लिए आवश्यक अगले तीन कदमों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
The students of class 11 of 'AL Public School' decided to host a farewell party to students of class 12. A core team was formed that brainstormed and identified various activities that needed to be performed for the same. It was decided that the arrangements for refreshments, sound and music, tentage, gifts, invitations and cultural programme are required to be made. The students then divided the work into manageable activities so that duplication is avoided and burden of work is shared.

The students were excited that they were managing the whole event themselves.

(i) The students of class 11 have performed one of the steps in the process of organising. Identify the step.
(ii) State the next three steps that the students need to perform to complete the process of organising successfully.

key_points: (i) Division of work into manageable activities / Departmentation
(ii) Step 2: Assignment of duties to individuals; Step 3: Delegation of authority; Step 4: Establishing reporting relationships / Coordination

questions.solution:
(i) The step performed by the Class 11 students is Division of Work (also called Departmentation or Identification and Division of Work). They identified all the activities needed for the farewell — refreshments, sound and music, tentage, gifts, invitations, and cultural programme — and divided the total work into smaller, manageable activities to prevent duplication and distribute the workload.

(ii) The next three steps in the process of organising that the students need to perform are: First, Grouping and Departmentation — the identified activities should be grouped into logical clusters based on similarity, so that teams can be formed for each area (e.g., a team for refreshments, a team for cultural programme, etc.). Second, Assignment of Duties — specific tasks should be allocated to individual members of each team based on their abilities and interests, so that each person knows exactly what they are responsible for. Third, Delegation of Authority — each team leader and member should be given the necessary authority to carry out their assigned duties, along with a clear definition of reporting relationships so that everyone knows to whom they are accountable and who can give them instructions.

'नोवल स्टोर्स' किराना दुकानों की एक श्रृंखला है जिसने उपभोक्ता संतुष्टि के आधार पर अपनी प्रतिष्ठा बनाई है। यह अपने उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले उत्पादों के लिए जानी जाती है जिसमें विस्तृत विविधता सहित बेकरी, डेयरी उत्पाद तथा पकाने के लिए तैयार खाने की किट आदि सम्मिलित हैं, जो विभिन्न ग्राहकों की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करती हैं। स्टोर नियमित रूप से ग्राहकों से प्रतिक्रिया लेता है और उसी के अनुसार माल का स्टॉक करता है।

स्टोर ग्राहकों के बीच अपनी आकर्षक योजनाओं जैसे 'एक खरीदिए एक मुफ्त पाइए' प्रस्ताव तथा साप्ताहिक छूट आदि के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, जिनका विज्ञापन इनकी वेबसाइट पर किया जाता है।

एक बार जब माल निर्मित हो जाता है, तो उसे पैक किए जाने, ब्राण्ड किए जाने तथा प्रवर्तन के पश्चात् 'नोवल स्टोर्स' इनको सही स्थान पर, सही मात्रा में एवं सही समय पर ग्राहकों को उपलब्ध कराने का आश्वासन देता है। ग्राहक ऑनलाइन आदेश दे सकते हैं और अपने घर पर सुपुर्दगी का चयन कर सकते हैं अथवा एक चुने गए समय पर स्टोर से भी उठा सकते हैं। परिणामस्वरूप, 'नोवल स्टोर्स' के आगम में प्रति वर्ष वृद्धि हो रही है और लाभ बढ़ रहे हैं।

उपर्युक्त स्थिति में विपणन मिश्र के जिन तत्त्वों पर प्रकाश डाला गया है उन्हें पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
'Novel Stores' is a chain of grocery stores that has built its reputation on customer satisfaction. It is known for its high-quality products, including a wide variety of bakery, dairy products and ready-to-cook meal kits, etc. catering to diverse customer needs. The store regularly takes feedback from the customers and stocks items accordingly.

The store is popular among the customers for its attractive schemes such as 'buy one get one free' offers and weekly discounts, etc. which are advertised on its website.

Once the goods are manufactured, packaged, branded and promoted, 'Novel Stores' ensures that they are made available to customers at the right place, in the right quantity and at the right time. Customers can place orders online and choose to get them delivered at their home or pick them up from the store at a selected time. As a result, the revenues of 'Novel Stores' are growing every year and profits are increasing.

Identify and explain the elements of marketing mix highlighted in the above case.

key_points: Product — high quality bakery, dairy, meal kits catering to diverse customer needs with packaging and branding
Price — attractive schemes like buy one get one free, weekly discounts
Promotion — advertising on the website
Place — ensuring availability at right place/time via home delivery and store pick-up

questions.solution: The following four elements of the Marketing Mix (4 Ps) are highlighted in the case of 'Novel Stores'. The first element is Product. Novel Stores offers a wide range of high-quality products including bakery items, dairy products, and ready-to-cook meal kits, catering to diverse customer needs. The store regularly collects feedback and adjusts its stock accordingly. Once goods are manufactured, they are also packaged and branded before being offered to customers — all of which are aspects of the product element. The second element is Price. Novel Stores attracts customers with value-for-money pricing strategies such as 'buy one get one free' offers and weekly discounts. These pricing schemes are designed to increase footfall, encourage repeat purchases, and build customer loyalty. The third element is Promotion. The store advertises its attractive schemes and offers through its website. This digital promotional activity creates customer awareness, communicates the value of deals, and drives traffic to the store as well as the online platform. The fourth element is Place (Physical Distribution). Novel Stores ensures that products are available to customers at the right place, in the right quantity, and at the right time. Customers have the flexibility to order online and choose home delivery or store pick-up at a time of their choosing — this efficient distribution system is the backbone of the store's growing revenue and profitability.
questions.solution_hindi: चार तत्त्व: (1) उत्पाद — विविध उच्च गुणवत्ता उत्पाद, पैकेजिंग, ब्रांडिंग; (2) मूल्य — BOGO और साप्ताहिक छूट; (3) संवर्धन — वेबसाइट पर विज्ञापन; (4) स्थान — होम डिलीवरी और स्टोर पिक-अप।

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के निर्देशन कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं चार बिन्दुओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four points of importance of directing function of management.

key_points: Initiates action
Integrates employees' efforts
Means of motivation
Facilitates change
Provides stability and balance in the organisation

sub_questions.solution: The directing function of management is important for the following four reasons. First, directing initiates action: plans and decisions remain mere intentions until someone actually begins executing them. Directing provides the trigger that sets organisational activities in motion by guiding employees on what to do, when to do it, and how to do it, thus converting plans into results. Second, directing integrates employee efforts: an organisation consists of many individuals with different skills and personalities working in various departments. Directing coordinates their individual efforts and ensures that all activities are aligned towards the common organisational objectives, turning a collection of individuals into a cohesive team. Third, directing is a means of motivation: through directing, managers use financial and non-financial incentives, inspirational leadership, and constructive communication to energise employees. Motivated employees work with greater dedication and enthusiasm, leading to higher productivity and lower absenteeism and turnover. Fourth, directing facilitates change: organisations must adapt to changing environments, new technologies, and market conditions. Directing helps managers guide and persuade employees to accept changes in methods, strategies, or structures. Through effective communication and leadership, resistance to change is overcome and a smooth transition is ensured, keeping the organisation competitive and progressive.

sub_questions.text: सम्प्रेषण की किन्हीं चार मनोवैज्ञानिक बाधाओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four psychological barriers of communication.

key_points: Premature evaluation
Lack of attention
Loss by transmission and poor retention
Distrust

sub_questions.solution: The following four psychological barriers hinder effective communication. The first is Premature Evaluation, which occurs when the receiver forms a judgement about the message before the sender has finished communicating. Instead of listening with an open mind, the receiver jumps to conclusions based on preconceived notions or biases. This leads to misunderstanding the true intent of the message and can damage the communication relationship. The second is Lack of Attention, which arises when the receiver is mentally preoccupied with other thoughts or personal concerns and is not paying full attention to the message being communicated. Even if the sender delivers the message clearly, the inattentive receiver fails to absorb it properly, leading to a breakdown in communication. The third is Loss by Transmission and Poor Retention. When a message passes through multiple levels of an organisation, a part of it is inevitably lost or distorted at each stage. Moreover, people tend to remember only a portion of what they hear or read over time. This poor retention means that by the time the message reaches its final destination, it may be incomplete or inaccurate. The fourth is Distrust, which emerges when there is a lack of confidence or trust between the sender and the receiver. If employees distrust their managers — perhaps due to past experiences of dishonesty or inconsistency — they may interpret even honest, well-intentioned messages negatively or with suspicion, causing the communication to fail to achieve its purpose.

'यमी फूड्स', एक तेजी से बढ़ती हुई स्नैक्स श्रृंखला, पिछले 13 वर्षों से इस व्यवसाय में है। यह समझते हुए कि पौष्टिक आहार की माँग बहुत तेजी से बढ़ रही है, कम्पनी ने स्वास्थ्यवर्धक स्नैक्स के क्षेत्र में प्रवेश की योजना बनाई। उन्होंने इस क्षेत्र में अनुभव-प्राप्त विपणन प्रबन्धक को काम पर रखने का निर्णय लिया। इसके लिए उन्होंने एक अग्रणी समाचार-पत्र में विज्ञापन दिया और 200 से अधिक आवेदन-पत्र प्राप्त किए।

मानव संसाधन प्रबन्धक ने ध्यानपूर्वक सभी आवेदन-पत्रों को देखा और उन आवेदकों के आवेदन-पत्रों को रद्द कर दिया, जिनके पास आधारभूत योग्यताएँ नहीं थीं। नौकरी की आवश्यकताओं के अनुरूप न होने वाले उम्मीदवारों को छाँटने के लिए संक्षिप्त परिचयात्मक बातचीत भी आयोजित की गई। उसके बाद चुने गए उम्मीदवारों को एक परीक्षा देने के लिए कहा गया जिससे उनकी बुद्धिमत्ता, व्यक्तिगत विशेषताओं आदि का मापन कर सकें। वे उम्मीदवार जिन्होंने परीक्षा में अच्छा प्रदर्शन किया, उन्हें कार्य पर उनकी उपयुक्तता के मूल्यांकन के लिए एक औपचारिक गहन बातचीत के लिए आमंत्रित किया गया। एक उम्मीदवार को नियुक्ति-पत्र के माध्यम से विपणन प्रबन्धक की भूमिका के लिए नियुक्ति की तिथि का उल्लेख करते हुए नौकरी-प्रस्ताव दिया गया।

लेकिन नौकरी-प्रस्ताव देने से पहले, 'यमी फूड्स' ने चयन-प्रक्रिया के तीन चरणों का निष्पादन किया जिनकी चर्चा उपर्युक्त में नहीं की गई है।

चरणों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
'Yummi Foods', a fast-growing snacks chain has been in business for the last 13 years. Realising that there is a growing demand for nutritious food, the company planned to enter the healthy snacks segment. They decided to hire a Marketing Manager with an experience in this segment. For this, they gave an advertisement in a leading newspaper and received more than 200 applications.

The Human Resource Manager carefully went through all the application forms and removed the application forms of those applicants who did not meet the basic qualifications. Short introductory interactions were also held to filter out candidates who did not match the job requirements. The shortlisted candidates were then asked to take a test designed to measure their intelligence, personality traits, etc. Candidates who performed well in the test were invited for a formal in-depth conversation to be evaluated on their suitability for the job. A job offer was made to a candidate for the role of a Marketing Manager through an appointment letter mentioning the joining date.

But before the job offer was made, 'Yummi Foods' had performed three steps in the process of selection which are not mentioned above.

Identify and explain the steps.

key_points: Reference checks — verifying the background, credentials, and character of the selected candidate
Medical/Physical examination — checking the candidate's fitness for the job
Selection decision — formally choosing the candidate before the job offer

questions.solution: The selection process steps already mentioned in the case are: screening of application forms, preliminary interview, selection tests, and employment interview, followed by the job offer (appointment letter). The three steps that were performed but not mentioned are as follows. The first is Reference and Background Checks. Before extending the job offer, Yummi Foods would have verified the information provided by the selected candidate by contacting the references they had supplied. This step involves checking the candidate's academic credentials, previous employment record, and character through former employers, educational institutions, or personal references, to confirm that all claims made by the candidate are truthful and accurate. The second is Medical Examination. Prior to making the final job offer, the company would have required the shortlisted candidate to undergo a medical or physical fitness examination. This step ensures that the candidate is physically and mentally fit to perform the job of Marketing Manager. It also protects the company from future liability if health issues affecting job performance emerge after appointment. The third is the Selection Decision. After all the preceding steps — tests, interviews, reference checks, and medical examination — a formal selection decision must be made by the competent authority in the organisation. This involves reviewing all the information gathered and formally deciding which candidate is most suitable for the position, before the appointment letter is issued.
